name: Aya Studio
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Aya Studio is a cartoon studio for kids' creators, teachers and parents. Describe a scene and get cartoon pictures in styles like 3D, 2D, anime or storybook. Save a character once and keep it looking the same in every picture and clip. Turn a picture into a short animated clip with sound, make a character talk with lip sync, compose original kids' songs, and record voice-overs in English, Arabic, French and many other languages.

Aya Studio makes cartoons only, never photorealistic images. Sign in with your Aya Studio account to use it. Clips, talking characters and songs take a few minutes to finish. For full episodes with a timeline editor, open the studio at ayastudio.si.
summary_ja: 子ども向けの絵や短いアニメ、歌、ナレーションを制作する。
limitations_ja: Aya Studioアカウントが必要。写実的な画像には非対応と説明。
